title: Boss Challenge: Element Detective
summary: Use everything you know about atoms, electron shells and the periodic table to identify 8 mystery elements from clues.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: applying knowledge of atomic structure and the periodic table (Criteria A and C)

objectives: I can identify an element from its atomic structure, position and properties.
I can combine several clues to reach a conclusion efficiently.
misconceptions: One clue is always enough to identify an element.
